verdict.rationale: The only direct ecosystem signal is the docs' mention of third-party, non-official SDKs in other languages. Open-weight licensing and community reports of local/self-hosted use (e.g., Devstral running locally, Mistral as a self-hosted option) suggest third-party tooling exists, but the pack names no specific tools. missing for 10: evidence of curated lists, named third-party tools or routers, integrations with active maintainers, and independent corroboration of ecosystem health.
